# homeassistant_input_number (Resource)

A number helper (`input_number`): a number in a range, shown as a slider or an input box.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A target temperature, shown as an input box. The entity is
# input_number.thermostat_target.
resource "homeassistant_input_number" "thermostat_target" {
  name                = "Thermostat Target"
  icon                = "mdi:thermometer"
  min                 = 5
  max                 = 30
  step                = 0.5
  mode                = "box"
  unit_of_measurement = "°C"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max` (Number) Highest value. Must be greater than `min`.
- `min` (Number) Lowest value.
- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.

### Optional

- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `initial` (Number) Value the helper starts with when Home Assistant starts, between `min` and `max`. Unset, it restores the value it had before the restart. The provider never manages the current value.
- `mode` (String) How the UI shows the helper: `slider` or `box`. Defaults to `slider`.
- `step` (Number) Step between values. Must be greater than 0. Defaults to `1`.
- `unit_of_measurement` (String) Unit of the value, e.g. `°C`.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `input_number.<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an input_number helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_input_number.thermostat_target thermostat_target
```
